28    //The play page of the problem of a set connection. Its view variables come in two parts: what the
29    //page has around any problem ($page: the player, the mode) and what changes with the problem
30    //($problem), which is all a page will need to show the next problem without loading again.
31    //$classroomAssignment: the class assignment the problem is played in, with its collections, set by
32    //its route (ClassroomsController::play()): its problems are the row of buttons and Next walks them.
33    /** @param array<string, mixed>|null $classroomAssignment */
34    public function __construct(int $setConnectionID, ServerRequest $request, private ?array $classroomAssignment = null)
35    {
36        $this->buildPage();
37        $this->buildProblem($setConnectionID, $request);
38    }

53    private function buildPage(): void
54    {
55        //What only some modes have: the link of the time mode to its next problem without a skip and
56        //the difficulty slider of the rating mode, which their routes set
57        $this->page['noSkipNextLink'] = '';
58        $this->page['difficulty'] = null;
59        if (Auth::isInRatingMode() || Auth::isInTimeMode())
60            $this->page['_title'] = 'Tsumego Hero';
61        //The menu item of the mode played
62        if (Auth::isInLevelMode())
63            $this->page['_page'] = 'level mode';
64        elseif (Auth::isInRatingMode())
65            $this->page['_page'] = 'rating mode';
66        elseif (Auth::isInTimeMode())
67            $this->page['_page'] = 'time mode';
68
69        $maxHealth = Util::getHealthBasedOnLevel(Auth::getWithDefault('level', 0));
70        $this->page['maxHealth'] = $maxHealth;
71        $this->page['fullHeart'] = $maxHealth >= 8 ? 'heart1small' : 'heart1';
72        $this->page['emptyHeart'] = $maxHealth >= 8 ? 'heart2small' : 'heart2';
73        $this->page['accountBlocked'] = Auth::isLoggedIn() && (bool) Auth::getUser()['blocked'];
74        $this->page['isAllowedToContribute'] = Auth::isLoggedIn() && BasePolicy::canPropose(Auth::getIdentity());
75        $this->page['canAddMoreTags'] = Auth::isLoggedIn() && TagConnectionTable::canCurrentUserAddTag();
76        $this->page['classroomAssignment'] = $this->classroomAssignment;
77    }

79    private function buildProblem(int $setConnectionID, ServerRequest $request): void
80    {
81        $setConnection = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('SetConnection')->find()->where(['id' => $setConnectionID])->first();
82        if (!$setConnection)
83            throw new NotFoundException("Set connection " . $setConnectionID . " wasn't found in the database.");
84        $tsumegoID = (int) $setConnection->tsumego_id;
85        //The set connection's foreign key deletes it with its problem
86        $tsumego = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Tsumego')->get($tsumegoID);
87        //A problem in the trash is gone for everyone but the admins, who can take it back
88        if ($tsumego->deleted !== null && !Auth::isAdmin())
89            throw new NotFoundException('Problem not found');
90
91        $set = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Set')->get($setConnection->set_id);
92        AuthorizationComponent::require(SetPolicy::canPlay(Auth::getIdentity(), $set));
93        Util::setCookie('lastVisit', $tsumegoID);
94
95        $tsumegoVariant = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('TsumegoVariant')->find()->where(['tsumego_id' => $tsumegoID])->first();
96        $tsumegoFilters = new TsumegoFilters();
97        $tsumegoStatus = self::tsumegoStatus($tsumegoID);
98        $goldenTsumego = $tsumegoStatus == TsumegoStatusTable::$GOLDEN;
99        $amountOfOtherCollection = TsumegoUtil::countTsumegosFromSet((int) $set->id);
100        $sgf = self::acceptedSgf($tsumegoID);
101        //Solved for the current mode: in time mode every problem is presented fresh, so this stays
102        //false until it is solved
103        $solved = TsumegoUtil::isSolvedForCurrentMode($tsumegoStatus);
104
105        $this->problem['og'] = self::openGraph($setConnection, $set, $tsumego, $sgf, $amountOfOtherCollection);
106        if (!empty($tsumego->semeai_type))
107        {
108            $this->problem['multipleChoiceTriangles'] = count(Util::getFollowingSgfCoordinates($sgf->sgf, strpos($sgf->sgf, 'TR') + 2));
109            $this->problem['multipleChoiceSquares'] = count(Util::getFollowingSgfCoordinates($sgf->sgf, strpos($sgf->sgf, 'SQ') + 2));
110        }
111        $this->buildNavigation($setConnection, $set, $tsumegoFilters);
112
113        $boardSize = self::boardSizeFromSetTitle($set->title);
114        $this->buildPlayerColor($request, $sgf->sgf, $tsumegoVariant != null
115            || ($tsumego->semeai_type ?? 0) != 0
116            || $boardSize != 19
117            || in_array($set->id, self::SETS_PLAYED_AS_BLACK));
118        //The corner is purely a visual mirror, it never affects solving. "Original" shows the
119        //problem's canonical orientation, which besogo normalizes to top-left.
120        $this->problem['corner'] = Auth::getBoardOrientationSetting() === UserTable::BOARD_ORIENTATION_SETTING_ORIGINAL ? 'top-left' : self::randomCorner();
121
122        //The description and the answers are stored in the true colors of the stones; when the board
123        //is inverted, they swap Black and White to match what the player sees
124        $swapColors = $this->problem['swapColors'];
125        $this->problem['displayDescription'] = $swapColors ? self::swapColorWords($tsumego->description) : $tsumego->description;
126        $displayAnswers = $tsumegoVariant?->extract(['answer1', 'answer2', 'answer3', 'answer4']);
127        if ($displayAnswers !== null && $swapColors)
128            $displayAnswers = array_map(fn($answer) => $answer === null ? null : self::swapColorWords($answer), $displayAnswers);
129        $this->problem['displayAnswers'] = $displayAnswers;
130
131        $this->problem['solved'] = $solved;
132        //A problem solved before is played again for a class assignment, which counts the solve on its own
133        $this->problem['assignmentReplay'] = $this->classroomAssignment !== null && $solved && empty($this->problem['solvedForAssignment']);
134        //Reset opens the problem again on the route it is played from, so a retry in the training or
135        //in a class assignment stays there
136        if ($this->classroomAssignment !== null)
137            $this->problem['resetLink'] = ClassroomAssignmentTable::playLink((int) $this->classroomAssignment['id'], (int) $setConnection->id);
138        else
139            $this->problem['resetLink'] = (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode() ? MistakeTraining::$PLAY_LINK_PREFIX : '/') . (int) $setConnection->id;
140
141        $this->problem['isAllowedToTag'] = Auth::isLoggedIn() && TagConnectionPolicy::canAdd(Auth::getIdentity(), $tsumego);
142        $this->problem['tagData'] = TagTable::getForTsumego($tsumegoID);
143        $this->problem['userSetsJson'] = json_encode(self::playerSets($tsumegoID));
144        $this->problem['hasSgfProposal'] = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Sgf')->exists([
145            'tsumego_id' => $tsumegoID,
146            'user_id' => Auth::getUserID(),
147            'sgf_status_id' => SgfTable::STATUS_PROPOSED]);
148        $this->problem['requestSolution'] = false;
149        if ($request->getQuery('requestSolution') !== null)
150        {
151            AuthorizationComponent::require(AdminPolicy::canRequestSolution(Auth::getIdentity()));
152            $this->problem['requestSolution'] = AdminActivityLogger::log(AdminActivityTypeTable::SOLUTION_REQUEST, $tsumegoID);
153        }
154
155        $boardsBitmask = BoardSelector::filterValidBits(Auth::isLoggedIn() ? Auth::getUser()['boards_bitmask'] : BoardSelector::$DEFAULT_BOARDS_BITMASK);
156        $this->problem['boardSelection'] = BoardSelector::selectBoard($boardsBitmask, $goldenTsumego, $set->board_theme_index);
157        $this->problem['isSandbox'] = $set->public == 0 && $set->user_id === null;
158        $this->problem['goldenTsumego'] = $goldenTsumego;
159        $this->problem['sgf'] = $sgf;
160        $this->problem['set'] = $set;
161        $this->problem['tsumego'] = $tsumego;
162        $this->problem['tsumegoStatus'] = $tsumegoStatus;
163        $this->problem['tv'] = $tsumegoVariant;
164        $this->problem['setConnection'] = $setConnection;
165        $this->problem['setConnections'] = TsumegoUtil::getSetConnectionsWithTitles($tsumegoID);
166        $this->problem['tsumegoFilters'] = $tsumegoFilters;
167        $this->problem['amountOfOtherCollection'] = $amountOfOtherCollection;
168        $this->problem['tsumegoXPAndRating'] = new TsumegoXPAndRating($tsumego, $tsumegoStatus, (int) $setConnection->id);
169    }

171    public static function swapColorWords(string $text): string
172    {
173        return preg_replace_callback(
174            '/\b(Black|black|White|white)\b/',
175            fn($match) => ['Black' => 'White', 'black' => 'white', 'White' => 'Black', 'white' => 'black'][$match[1]],
176            $text);
177    }

180    private const SETS_PLAYED_AS_BLACK = [109, 233, 236, 239, 243, 244, 246, 251, 253];

182    private static function tsumegoStatus(int $tsumegoID): string
183    {
184        if (!Auth::isLoggedIn())
185            return TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED;
186        return TsumegoStatusTable::statusOf(Auth::getUserID(), $tsumegoID) ?? TsumegoStatusTable::$VISITED;
187    }

189    //The newest accepted SGF of the problem, a placeholder board when it has none
190    private static function acceptedSgf(int $tsumegoID): Sgf
191    {
192        return TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Sgf')->find()
193            ->select(['id', 'sgf', 'user_id', 'created'])
194            ->where(['tsumego_id' => $tsumegoID, 'sgf_status_id' => SgfTable::STATUS_ACCEPTED])
195            ->orderByDesc('id')
196            ->first()
197            ?? new Sgf(['id' => null, 'sgf' => Constants::$SGF_PLACEHOLDER, 'user_id' => null, 'created' => null]);
198    }

200    //A set titled e.g. "Life and death 9x9" is played on that board size, everything else on 19x19
201    private static function boardSizeFromSetTitle(string $title): int
202    {
203        $boardSize = 19;
204        for ($size = 2; $size <= 19; $size++)
205            if (strpos(';' . $title, $size . 'x' . $size))
206                $boardSize = $size;
207        return $boardSize;
208    }

210    //The player's own sets for the heart dropdown, and which of them have the problem already
211    private static function playerSets(int $tsumegoID): array
212    {
213        if (!Auth::isLoggedIn())
214            return [];
215        $sets = Util::query("
216SELECT s.id, s.title, sc.tsumego_id
217FROM `set` s
218LEFT JOIN set_connection sc ON sc.set_id = s.id AND sc.tsumego_id = ?
219WHERE s.user_id = ?
220ORDER BY s.title", [$tsumegoID, Auth::getUserID()]);
221        return array_map(fn($set) => ['id' => $set['id'], 'title' => $set['title'], 'contains' => $set['tsumego_id'] != null], $sets);
222    }

224    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
225    private static function openGraph(SetConnection $setConnection, Set $set, Tsumego $tsumego, Sgf $sgf, int $amountOfOtherCollection): array
226    {
227        $title = ($set->title ?? '') . ' ' . $setConnection->num . '/' . $amountOfOtherCollection;
228        //The descriptions and the image both use the true colors of the SGF
229        $description = strip_tags($tsumego->description ?? '');
230        $author = $tsumego->author;
231        if ($author !== '' && $author !== 'Unknown')
232            $description .= ' - by ' . $author;
233        if (trim($description) === '')
234            $description = $title;
235
236        return [
237            'title' => $title,
238            'description' => $description,
239            'image' => Router::url('/tsumego-image/' . $setConnection->id
240                . '?v=' . Constants::$TSUMEGO_IMAGE_VERSION
241                . '&t=' . ($sgf->created?->getTimestamp() ?? ''), true),
242            'image_type' => 'image/png',
243            'image_width' => Constants::$OG_IMAGE_WIDTH,
244            'image_height' => Constants::$OG_IMAGE_HEIGHT,
245            'image_alt' => $title,
246            'url' => Router::url('/' . $setConnection->id, true),
247            'type' => 'website',
248            'site_name' => 'Tsumego',
249            'locale' => 'en_US',
250            'twitter_card' => 'summary_large_image',
251        ];
252    }

254    //The row of problem buttons, the previous and next links and the title of the modes that walk
255    //a list: a class assignment, the level mode and the mistake training. The board always gets both
256    //arrows, and an empty one is the arrow turned off.
257    private function buildNavigation(SetConnection $setConnection, Set $set, TsumegoFilters $tsumegoFilters): void
258    {
259        $setConnectionID = (int) $setConnection->id;
260        $this->problem['tsumegoButtons'] = null;
261        $this->problem['previousLink'] = '';
262        $this->problem['queryTitle'] = '';
263        if ($this->classroomAssignment !== null)
264        {
265            $buttons = ClassroomAssignmentTable::playButtons($this->classroomAssignment, (int) Auth::getUserID(), $setConnectionID);
266            $this->problem['tsumegoButtons'] = SetNavigationButtons::around($buttons, $setConnection);
267            $this->problem['_title'] = ClassroomAssignmentTable::title($this->classroomAssignment) . ' ' . $buttons->currentOrder . '/' . $buttons->highestTsumegoOrder . ' on Tsumego Hero';
268            $currentButton = array_find((array) $buttons, fn($button) => $button->setConnectionID == $setConnectionID);
269            $this->problem['solvedForAssignment'] = $currentButton?->status === ClassroomAssignmentTable::BUTTON_SOLVED;
270            //Past either end of a class assignment is the page of its class
271            $this->problem = array_merge($this->problem, $buttons->previousAndNextLink(null, $setConnectionID, null, '/classes/' . (int) $this->classroomAssignment['classroom_id']));
272        }
273        elseif (Auth::isInLevelMode())
274        {
275            $buttons = new TsumegoButtons($tsumegoFilters, $setConnectionID, null, $set->id);
276            $this->problem['tsumegoButtons'] = SetNavigationButtons::around($buttons, $setConnection);
277            $collectionTitle = $tsumegoFilters->query == 'topics' ? $set->title : (Util::cookie('lastSet') ?? 'Tsumego');
278            $this->problem['_title'] = $collectionTitle . ' ' . $setConnection->num . '/' . $buttons->highestTsumegoOrder . ' on Tsumego Hero';
279            $this->problem = array_merge($this->problem, $buttons->previousAndNextLink($tsumegoFilters, $setConnectionID, $set));
280            $this->problem['queryTitle'] = $tsumegoFilters->getSetTitle($set) . $buttons->getPartitionTitleSuffix() . ' ' . $buttons->currentOrder . '/' . $buttons->highestTsumegoOrder;
281        }
282        elseif (Auth::isInMistakeTrainingMode())
283        {
284            $buttons = MistakeTraining::buildQueueButtons($setConnectionID);
285            $this->problem['tsumegoButtons'] = SetNavigationButtons::around($buttons, $setConnection);
286            $this->problem['_title'] = 'Mistake Training ' . $buttons->currentOrder . '/' . $buttons->highestTsumegoOrder . ' on Tsumego Hero';
287            //No link before the first problem: the queue page would serve the first due one again
288            $this->problem['previousLink'] = $buttons->previousAndNextLink($tsumegoFilters, $setConnectionID, $set, '')['previousLink'];
289            //The row keeps what today already solved, so "Next" skips it instead of serving the neighbour
290            $this->problem['nextLink'] = MistakeTraining::nextLink($buttons, $setConnectionID);
291        }
292    }

294    //Which color the player plays, and whether the board colors are swapped for it (when the SGF
295    //starts with the other color). "Original" plays the SGF as designed, "Random" picks a side.
296    //$playAsBlack: the problem is about the actual black and white groups (variants, semeai, small
297    //boards, some sets), so the player is black. ?playercolor=black|white overrides all of it.
298    private function buildPlayerColor(ServerRequest $request, string $sgf, bool $playAsBlack): void
299    {
300        $sgfColor = SgfParser::firstMoveColor($sgf);
